source_priority: Owner request: match approved generated side study assets/knight/concepts/side-01.png first, including broad cheek, rounded muzzle and wide neck/chest
Original black Lichess sprite for best-effort secondary overhead fit, with mirrored white as a check
Selected black candidate 2 enlargement for secondary detail interpretation

reference_camera.basis: Bounded secondary camera fit, after matching side guide geometry; remains inferred

geometry.method: Guide-derived broad continuous skull/cheek and gently conical rounded muzzle joined to a wide S neck/chest; thick arched mane, swept ears, socket-seated eyes, flatter foot. Single Y-depth reduction retained XZ side profiles.

observations: Previous committed thin pointed model preserved before edits in history/knight/11-before-guide-match.
Large side masses rebuilt directly from the approved guide; same-base-width and floor overlay reviewed before secondary depth/camera work.
Small gap behind the ear closed; sloping forehead corrected against actual source outline; cheek cross-sections rounded.
Single targeted Y-depth correction narrows the head and upper neck, retaining guide XZ profiles. Eyes are seated on the final smoothed socket surfaces.
Level profile, front, three-quarter, side, opposite and reference-camera renders visually inspected.
All nine mesh objects have one connected closed shell and positive volume; seven are visible. Saved camera/mesh and viewer interaction checks pass.
Final original silhouette IoU is 88.46% with 6.20 original-pixel mean boundary discrepancy; frozen previous camera on the same final geometry gives 85.76%.
limitations: The generated side guide is an owner-approved interpretation. Side camera elevation, depth and unseen surfaces remain inferred.

The side study and original overhead silhouette are not simultaneously matched exactly. The guide-derived chest and head extent remain visibly different in the original view, despite bounded framing and one Y-only depth correction.
Fine carving and local anatomical transitions remain approximations. Neutral clay lighting differs from wood; no material study was performed.
Mane, ears, eyes and pedestal are separate closed components intersecting the continuous head-neck skin, not fused for manufacturing.
Native browser rendering was not exercised. Controls, Front/Side presets and saved-camera projection were checked with the Node VM harness.

guide_camera.note: Approximate inferred study camera; fixed base width and physical floor. No rotation, warp, or anisotropic fit of the source image.
